description: Source code for the GpuMem class managing GPU memory tracking using eBPF, including initialization, dumping memory snapshots, and traversing GPU memory totals.

classes.name: GpuMem
classes.description: Class managing GPU memory tracking and reporting using eBPF programs.

methods.name: GpuMem::~GpuMem
methods.description: Destructor that detaches the tracepoint for GPU memory tracking.

methods.name: GpuMem::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the GPU memory tracking by loading and attaching eBPF programs and maps.

methods.name: GpuMem::setGpuMemTotalMap
methods.description: Sets the internal GPU memory total map.

methods.name: GpuMem::dump
methods.description: Dumps current GPU memory usage snapshots into a string.

methods.name: GpuMem::traverseGpuMemTotals
methods.description: Traverses GPU memory totals, invoking a callback for each entry.
